mapper.select: SELECT r.id,r.reservation_no AS reservationNo,m.name AS memberName,c.name AS courseName,r.reserved_at AS reservedAt,r.player_count AS playerCount,r.status FROM reservations r JOIN members m ON m.id=r.member_id JOIN golf_courses c ON c.id=r.course_id ORDER BY r.reserved_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservations r JOIN members m ON m.id=r.member_id JOIN golf_courses c ON c.id=r.course_id
